grammar.title: Resolutely with 坚决
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 坚决 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 坚决 (jiānjué) means "resolutely, firmly" — describing an action or decision made with strong, unwavering determination. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.zh: 他坚决不同意这个办法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiānjué bù tóngyì zhège bànfǎ.
sentences.en: He resolutely disagrees with this method.

sentences.zh: 我们坚决支持这个决定。

sentences.en: She's determined to leave this place.
